## 2026-06-21 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0119 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.8.2, PURE-DOCS DESIGN): SVA infix binary-operator parse bug — FIX DESIGN + DECISION (direction A)

Design/decision leaf for the `H.12.5.8` SVA infix parse bug whose root cause `-0118` established. **DECISION = direction A (grammar restructure to a §16 precedence cascade); option B (engine direct-LR elimination) is DOMINATED.** PURE-DOCS ⇒ no grammar/Rust/generated/release/schema/ledger change; clippy not invoked; no gate run. SV stays cert `UNKNOWN=56`; live status UNCHANGED. Splits `H.12.5.8` → `.8.2` (this, done) + `.8.3` (implement, the new lane-2 frontier).

- **Decision rationale (tools-first):** IEEE 1800-2017 **Table 16-3** (§16.12, extracted from the vendored LRM) gives a real SVA operator precedence/associativity (`[*]`≻`##`≻`throughout`≻`within`≻`intersect`≻`{not,nexttime}`≻`and`≻`or`≻`iff`≻`until`-family≻implication≻`{always,eventually}`≻guards; `throughout`/`iff`/`until`-family/implication right-assoc, the rest left). The current grammar is a FLAT precedence-free operator list, so a precedence cascade is REQUIRED regardless of A or B — a naive direct-LR `β (op β)*` would flatten all operators to one precedence + left-assoc (wrong). Therefore B = the same grammar restructure PLUS a new high-blast-radius engine feature for identical correctness ⇒ A wins (level-1 declarative fix, proven `next (OP next)*` idiom, one grammar file + SV regen, correctness-first, smallest blast radius).
- **Cascade blueprint designed:** sequence layer `seq_or → seq_and → seq_intersect → seq_within → seq_throughout → seq_delay(##) → seq_unary`; property layer `prop_guard → prop_temporal → prop_impl → prop_until → prop_iff → prop_or → prop_and → prop_not → prop_primary`; left-assoc `next (op next)*`, right-assoc `next (op level)?`, both profiles, non-binary operand forms preserved at the unary base.
- **`.8.3` implementation sub-questions captured:** AST-shape preservation (binary `{kind,lhs,rhs}` fold) vs schema bump + lockstep ceremony; Annex A.2.10 operand-type re-confirmation; book reconciliation of the `developer-architecture.md` direct-LR overclaim.
- **Separate future general work (NOT this lane):** completing the engine direct-LR eliminator (option B) — would also fix the sibling un-eliminated `block_event_expression` (`grammars/systemverilog.ebnf:681`).
- **OUTCOME:** `.8.3` (new frontier) implements the cascade per the blueprint — large + signoff-critical, best taken with fresh context. Detail: `docs/tasks/GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-H12582-infix-binop-lr-fix-design.md`.

## 2026-06-18 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0114 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.6.2.2.1, PURE-DOCS): M2a reach-honesty empirical confirmation + refined design (pre-implement)

First sub-step of the M2a engine fix (`H.12.5.6.2.2`): rebuild-from-source DEBUG `ast_pipeline`, reproduce the decisive baseline, empirically confirm the `-0113` WHY via the reach-path dump (the leaf's mandated "read the reach path before changing it"), and lock the implement design against what the tools show. Tools-first investigation REFINED and partially CORRECTED the `-0113` design, so the engine IMPLEMENT is split out as `.2.2.2`.

- **Decisive baseline reproduced (A side):** `PGEN_REACH_PATH_DUMP=1 PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DUMP_ALL=1 … --grammar-profile sv_2017 --entry-rule systemverilog_file --count 40 --seed 0` → `total=1289 proof=1 witness=1204 UNKNOWN=84 spf=0 fully_certified=false` (matches the layer-A pointer).
- **WHY empirically confirmed (resolves `-0113` open-Q (a)):** the reach-path dump shows the constraint body is discovered via `package_or_generate_item_declaration_sv_2017` **branch `o8` → `extern_constraint_declaration` → … → constraint_block` (store-gated, FEWER hops), beating the in-class **branch `o9` → class_declaration → … → class_constraint → constraint_declaration → constraint_block** (non-gated, LONGER). `constraint_block` is the SHARED subtree; first-discovery-wins assigns it the extern predecessor. Re-routing the discovery edge suffices (directives follow discovered predecessors), but the fix must beat a SHORTER route — a same-hop-distance tie-break (the `prefer_non_self_recursive_reference_sites` shape) is INSUFFICIENT.
- **R1 — re-routable subset is the `constraint_block` subtree ONLY (target ≠ ~66):** `extern_constraint_declaration(_sv_2017)` itself is extern-ONLY (its witness REQUIRES rendering `class_scope` = a declared class) → re-routing can't witness it; it + the `known_unscoped_class_scope_*` store-gated identifiers belong to STORE-AWARE-GEN. The `-0113` "UNKNOWN 84 → ~66" target is OPTIMISTIC; the realistic re-route delta is the subtree subset (`constraint_block`/`constraint_block_item`/`constraint_expression`/`constraint_primary(_sv_2017)`/`constraint_set`/`solve_before_list`/`uniqueness_constraint(_sv_2017)`/`loop_variables`/`index_variable_identifier` + constraint-body `kw_*`).
- **R2 — detector all-gated rule fires (verified):** all 4 `class_scope_type` head alternatives are store-gated (`scoped_class_scope_identifier` `:1047` `lacks_fact_attribute_equals … class`; `known_unscoped_class_scope_class_identifier` `:1025` `fact_attribute_equals … class`; `…interface_class…` `:1028`; `…type_parameter…` `:1031`) ⇒ the conservative "an `Or` is gated iff EVERY alternative is gated" rule classifies the edge into `extern_constraint_declaration` store-gated; excluding it in pass-1 leaves `constraint_block` reachable only via the non-gated in-class route.
- **R3 — NEW second mechanism:** `scoped_class_scope_identifier`'s NEGATIVE `lacks_fact_attribute_equals` predicate is SATISFIED by an undeclared name, so a `class_scope` rendering that passes its predicate plausibly exists; the cluster's non-witnessing is ALSO influenced by which `class_scope_type` head alternative the reach pass / generator selects (the `-0113` probe rendered the gated bare-class `\foo ::`). This DISTINCT lever (which re-routing can't reach — it may witness `extern_constraint_declaration` itself) is handed to `.2.2.2`.
- **Safety property (de-risks `.2.2.2`):** `reach_hops` only selects a path; the parser adjudicates every probe ⇒ a wrong path choice CANNOT create a false witness (worst case = no improvement). The real risks (de-witnessing; perturbing the 6 fully-certified grammars) are caught by the required A/B + byte-identical checks; pass-2 fallback preserves reachability.
- **Refined detector design (the `.2.2.2` spec):** two-pass `reach_hops` (pass-1 exclude store-gated edges, pass-2 fallback to all-edges) + emitted-on-path tracking in the BFS `Discovery` struct; "store-gated edge `R→C`" = `C` mandatorily (profile/`Or`/optional-aware, cycle-guarded, transitively) renders a fact-query-`@predicate` rule whose consulted kind ∉ emitted-on-path; reuse `grammar_wellformedness::collect_emitted_fact_kinds` + `consulted_kinds_in_predicate` (the F1 machinery). GENERAL/parser-agnostic; precedent `prefer_non_self_recursive_reference_sites` (`stimuli_generator.rs:5714`).

## 2026-06-17 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0107 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.5.3.3.4.2.1.2.2.1, PURE-DOCS WHY+WHERE + SAFE DESIGN): context_member GENUINE-witness composition RESOLVED; `.4.2.1.2.2` split

The SV `UNKNOWN`→0 drive's frontier leaf `.4.2.1.2.2` (witness `context_member_method_call`) was scoped from the `-0101` design, which explicitly left the prelude↔method-call **composition** as an open question, and `-0102` got it wrong (false witness, reverted). This slice resolves it tools-first, with the parser as the only judge, and splits the leaf into a done DESIGN + a known-safe IMPLEMENT — no code change.

- **Baseline reproduced byte-identical** (seed 0): `total=1291 proof=1 witness=1204 UNKNOWN=86 spf=0`.
- **Minimal genuine-witness recipe pinned** (`parseability_probe --parse-dump-ast-pretty`, counting `context_member_method` AST nodes): a top-level decl of the chain head (satisfies the `has_fact(variable_binding,$head)` post-gate) + `callable_method_call_body` rendered as a CALL. **The `[idx]` is NOT required** — `int \foo ; (*\foo =+\foo .\foo .\foo ()*)` → **1** node; identical WITHOUT the decl → **0**; bare-ref → **0**. This refines the `-0101`/`-0102` `.foo[0].foo()` framing.
- **Two gaps pinned on the shipped generator** (`PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DEBUG_PROBES=1`): (A) SV emits no prelude (`gen_count_kinds` empty ⇒ `compute_reach_prelude`→`None`); (B) the `.3.3.1` mandatory-child forcing renders `[idx]` and `()` in SEPARATE probes, never together, never with a declared head. The binding+bare-ref probe is exactly the `.4.2.1.2.1` FALSE-witness shape (the deferred soundness gap credits a rule with 0 AST nodes), so the `UNKNOWN` count is necessary-but-NOT-sufficient.
- **Safe composition designed:** a `Presence` (`has_fact`) prelude with `captured=None` — the plannable driver arms only when `captured.is_some()`, so a Presence prelude is structurally inert in the plannable pass (no `-0102` trap, no driver change) — armed ONLY in the target-own pass, ONLY on the all-mandatory-children (call-forced) probe ⇒ a c2-shaped GENUINE witness; the genuineness oracle is the AST node, never the count.
- **Split:** `.4.2.1.2.2` → `.2.2.1` (DESIGN, done here) + `.2.2.2` (GENERATOR IMPLEMENT, new frontier). Detail: `docs/tasks/GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-H1255334212-2-context-member-genuine-witness-design.md`.

## 2026-06-16 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0100 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.5.3.3.4.2.2.1, GRAMMAR FIX, release 1.0.141, schema stays 4, ledger SV-0003): a real released-parser bug FIXED — a module-scope class-handle declaration `C a;` is no longer mis-parsed as a `net_declaration`

Implemented the `-0099` fix direction. A module-scope class-handle declaration `C a;` (with `C` a declared class) was mis-parsed as a `net_declaration` because `checked_nettype_identifier`'s store gate was under-specified; that emitted no `variable_binding` fact, so class-handle member-method chains were rejected. - **The fix (grammar only — `grammars/systemverilog.ebnf`):** `checked_nettype_identifier`'s `@predicate` tightened from `has_fact(type_name, $body)` to `fact_attribute_equals(type_name, $body, declaration_family, nettype)`. A declared **class** is also a `type_name`, so the bare gate let a class name satisfy the `net_declaration` user-nettype branch; the tightened gate resolves ONLY to a declared nettype (`declared_nettype_identifier` emits `type_name` with `declaration_family: nettype`). Per IEEE 1800 a class is not a `net_type`, so `C a;` is a `data_declaration`. Mirrors the proven `known_unscoped_block_class_type` / `checked_type_identifier` store-gate pattern (the rule's own comment cites it). **`rust/src/ast_pipeline/` (the parser-agnostic pipeline/engine) is UNTOUCHED** — SV logic lives in the SV grammar ([[feedback_prefer_grammar_leave_engine_alone]], [[feedback_grammar_rules_must_consult_store]]).
- **Verified (all green):** `C a;` → `data_declaration`/`variable_decl` (binds `a`; was `net_declaration`); module-scope `C a; … a.b[0].c()` REJECT→PASS and now witnesses `context_member_method`; built-in net `wire a;` still `net_declaration`; real user nettype `nettype logic NT; NT a;` preserved; undeclared-head chain still correctly rejected. SV cert-coverage **byte-identical** `total=1292 witness=1203 UNKNOWN=88 spf=0` at seeds 0/7/42 with the UNKNOWN **set** identical (the fix is a correctness re-route, NOT a cert-witness closure — closing `context_member_method_call`'s cert `UNKNOWN` is the separate `.4.2.1` generator pass). `--lint-grammar` clean (`ordered_choice_shadowing=0`; pre-existing `always_matches=6`). **SV external corpus 14/14**. `stimuli_cross_family_platform_gate` PASS (regex/vhdl/sv). SV shape-contract **14/14** including the new regression lock `systemverilog_class_handle_decl_is_data_declaration_not_net` (added to `rust/src/ast_shape_contract.rs`, the per-parser-family AST-shape **verification** runner — the established SV-0001/VHDL-0002 lock location, not engine code) and both existing `context_gated_method_chain` locks (no regression to the function-scope uvm shape). Clippy source-strict clean (generated-parser clippy non-strict, as established).
- **Lockstep:** ledger row `SV-0003`; SV contract Identity → 1.0.141 + schema-version note (schema stays 4 — `C a;` re-routes between the two existing `net_declaration`/`data_declaration` shapes, no new vocabulary); SV parser book changelog-index + schema-versioning timeline (4 unchanged @ 1.0.141); the Grammar Well-Formedness book chapter's SV arc (a *cert-neutral* bug-finding-oracle outcome — the `UNKNOWN`→0 drive surfaced a real shipped bug even though the coverage number did not move).

## 2026-06-16 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0099 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.5.3.3.4.2.2, PURE-DOCS WHY+WHERE): a real released-parser bug found — `checked_nettype_identifier` over-accepts a declared class as a nettype, so `C a;` at module scope is mis-parsed as a net declaration

Tools-first WHY+WHERE for the `-0098` secondary finding (a class-handle head does not witness the indexed member-method chain). Root-caused to a real released-parser bug in the M2 store-gating family. No code change (PURE-DOCS); fix routed to child `.4.2.2.1`. The cert-coverage gate acting as a bug-finding oracle: chasing why `context_member_method_call` won't witness for class-handle heads surfaced a latent declaration mis-categorization the external corpus never hit.

- **WHY.** `class C; endclass module m; C a; endmodule` → the declaration of `a` carries `"kind": "net_declaration"` (AST dump), whereas `int a;` carries `data_declaration → variable_decl`. A `net_declaration` never runs `variable_decl_assignment`, so it emits no `variable_binding` fact for `a`; therefore `context_member_method_call`'s `@predicate has_fact(variable_binding, $head)` (phase post) fails for a class-handle head and the indexed 3-level chain `a.b[0].c()` rejects (the non-indexed `a.b.c()` survives via `ident_postfix_chain`/`split_hierarchical`, which need no binding — which is why only the indexed chain exposes it).
- **WHERE.** `--trace-rules` shows `checked_nettype_identifier` matching `C`, and `net_declaration_sv_2017` branch 2/4 succeeding. The rule's gate (`systemverilog.ebnf:3310-3311`) is `@predicate has_fact(type_name, $body)` on `checked_nettype_identifier := declaration_identifier`. This is UNDER-specified: a class is also a `type_name` (`class C` emits `type_name` with `declaration_family: class`), so a class name satisfies the nettype gate — even though the rule's own comment states the intent is a declared nettype (`declaration_family: nettype`). The predicate never checks `declaration_family`. This is the classic store-consultation defect: the rule consults the store but with too weak a predicate (`feedback_grammar_rules_must_consult_store`). Per the LRM a class is not a nettype, so `C a;` (C a class) is a `data_declaration`, never a `net_declaration`.
- **FIX direction (verified-sound; → child `.4.2.2.1`).** Tighten the gate to `fact_attribute_equals(type_name, $body, declaration_family, nettype)`, mirroring the proven `known_unscoped_block_class_type` / `checked_type_identifier` store-gate the comment already cites. Then a class (or any non-nettype) name no longer matches as a nettype; `C a;` routes to `data_declaration` (class variable), binds `a`, and the member-method chain parses.
- **Preconditions tool-verified this session (so the fix is non-regressing in principle):** P1 — a genuine declared nettype `nettype logic NT; module m; NT a; endmodule` parses today and the tightened `fact_attribute_equals` gate preserves it (nettypes carry `declaration_family: nettype`); P2 — the SAME class-handle indexed chain `C a; … a.b[0].c()` PARSES and witnesses `context_member_method` in CLASS scope (where `net_declaration` is not a `class_item`, so only `data_declaration` matches and binds `a`) — exactly the module-scope outcome the fix reproduces.
- **Scope/route.** Language-changing grammar fix (`C a;` at module scope: `net_declaration` → `data_declaration`) ⇒ full lockstep in `.4.2.2.1` (regen, cert seeds 0/7/42, corpus 14/14, cross-family, linter, SV release + ledger + contract/parser-book/book/schema). Real released-parser bug ⇒ HIGH priority. Squarely the M2 store-gating class (`H.12.5.6` family); the over-gen-vs-bug adjudication is done here — it is a real bug. Does NOT block the `.4.2.1` cert witness (the `-0098` integral-head witness already proves `context_member_method_call` witnessable).
- **Status:** PURE-DOCS ⇒ no code/grammar/generated/release/schema/ledger/book change; clippy not invoked. SV cert stays `UNKNOWN=88`; SystemVerilog remains the only non-fully-certified shipped grammar. Live-status tracker UNCHANGED.
- Detail: `docs/tasks/GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-H1255334-422-classhandle-nettype-whywhere.md`.

## 2026-06-16 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0098 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.5.3.3.4.2, PURE-DOCS RE-ADJUDICATION): the `-0097` "context_member parser bug" premise is REFUTED — `a.b[0].c()` parses with a declared head; the cert UNKNOWN is a store-gated witness-reach gap, not a parser bug

Tools-first re-adjudication of leaf `H.12.5.5.3.3.4.2`, which `-0097` opened as *"a real latent released-parser bug — repair the grammar so `a.b[0].c()` parses."* That premise is **refuted on two checkable claims**; there is **no parser bug**. No code change (PURE-DOCS). This is a "be alert / root-cause fishy foundational results immediately" correction of the immediately-preceding adjudication.

- **Refutation 1 — the `@predicate` IS live.** `-0097` claimed the generated parser carries no `@predicate` on `context_member_method_call`. False: `generated/systemverilog_parser.rs:3041-3055` emits `Predicate(has_fact, [variable_binding, head], phase: Post)`. The "no predicate" reading came from a one-line-grep trap — rustfmt wraps `directives_by_rule.insert(` and the `"context_member_method_call"` string onto separate lines, so a single-line `grep` for both misses it. The grammar's `@predicate` (`systemverilog.ebnf:2892`) binds across the intervening comment to the rule (`:2906`) exactly as `ebnf.ebnf:70` prescribes.
- **Refutation 2 — `a.b[0].c()` PARSES (and witnesses the rule) with a declared head.** `-0097` claimed it is "rejected even with a declared head." False: `module m; int a; int x; initial x = a.b[0].c(); endmodule` → **PARSE OK**, and the accepted AST contains a `context_member_method` node (confirmed via `parseability_probe --parse-dump-ast-pretty`); `logic [3:0] a;` / `bit a;` heads likewise. The undeclared form correctly rejects — the rule's `post`-phase `has_fact(variable_binding, $head)` gate is the deliberate "regression firewall" (`systemverilog.ebnf:2876-2889`). `-0097`'s failing tests never established the binding: `class C; function void f; … a.b[0].c();` left `a` undeclared (reject at the chain, predicate fails); `module m; C a; …` rejected at the `C a;` declaration itself because `C` was an undeclared type (so `a` was never bound).
- **Baseline (deterministic ⇒ signal):** reproduced byte-identical — `total=1292 proof=1 witness=1203 UNKNOWN=88 spf=0` (seed 0, `PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DUMP_ALL=1`); both `context_member_method_call` and `direct_index_method_call` confirmed in the 88-rule UNKNOWN set.
- **True root cause — a store-gated WITNESS-REACH gap (not a parser bug).** `context_member_method_call` sits in `UNKNOWN` because the cert-coverage witness passes cannot *generate* a sample satisfying its `has_fact(variable_binding, $head)` gate: the sample needs a fact-emitting prelude — a variable declaration whose name matches the chain head — that the minimal reach derivation lacks. This is the `has_fact` analogue of the regex `\NN` "semantic-prelude reach" class. The existing C2.2 pass (`stimuli_generator.rs:2769 compute_reach_prelude`) is keyed purely on `fact_count_at_least` (`gen_count_kinds`) and emits *N* anonymous copies — neither `has_fact` support nor name-coupling. By the attribution rule this is a **generator constructor gap** (grammar + parser are both correct) → fix child `H.12.5.5.3.3.4.2.1` (extend the semantic-prelude reach to `has_fact`-gated rules with a name-coupled `variable_decl_assignment` prelude; closes `UNKNOWN 88→87`; GENERATOR capability, no grammar/release/ledger change).
- **Secondary finding (separate ticket `H.12.5.5.3.3.4.2.2`).** A declared class-handle head (`C a;`, C a declared class) does NOT witness the indexed chain (`C a; … a.b[0].c()` rejects at the `[`) while integral heads (`int`/`logic`/`bit`) do — a potential real gap for the realistic uvm class-handle shape `urme_container.elements[i].clone()`. Filed as its own WHY+WHERE leaf (tools-first: does a class-typed object declaration emit `variable_binding`, and should the form parse?), NOT this leaf's cert blocker (the integral-head witness already proves the rule reachable + witnessable).
- **Carrier 1 (`direct_index_method_call`, `.4.1`) unaffected** by this finding, but because `-0097` was shown unreliable on two checkable claims, its "effectively dead / subsumed" premise must be **independently re-verified** before any removal (its decisive A/B is mandatory regardless).
- **Status:** PURE-DOCS ⇒ no code/grammar/generated/release/schema/ledger/book change; clippy not invoked. SV cert stays `UNKNOWN=88`; SystemVerilog remains the only non-fully-certified shipped grammar. Live-status tracker UNCHANGED.

## 2026-06-16 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0097 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.5.3.3.4, PURE-DOCS ADJUDICATION): the 2 C-ii residual carriers are GRAMMAR-class, not generator parent-commit forcing — and a real latent SV parse bug surfaced

Tools-first adjudication of the leaf `H.12.5.5.3.3.4` question (per carrier: **(a)** ordered-choice shadowing / well-formedness defect → fix the grammar, vs **(b)** parent-commit GENERATOR forcing → force the parent `Or`). - **METHOD:** DEBUG `ast_pipeline` (`generated_parsers,ebnf_dual_run`), `PGEN_REACH_PATH_DUMP=1` + `PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DEBUG_PROBES=1` + `PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DUMP_ALL=1`, count 40 seed 0 — reproduced the post-`-0087` baseline `total=1292 proof=1 witness=1198 UNKNOWN=93 spf=0`, then read each M1b carrier's `[reach-path]` hop chain + `[plannable-probe]` sample, cross-checked against the TRANSFORMED `grammar_tree` (`--dump-gen-ast`).
- **CONFIRMED (the M1a fix did NOT resolve M1b):** the M1b carriers persist — `array_range_expression`, `bit_select_expression`, `direct_index_method_call`, `goto_repetition`, `context_member_method_call`, `constant_let_expression`, `class_scoped_tf_call`, `sequence_method_call` — across 4 contexts (continuous-assign/streaming-concat lvalue; `sequence_expr`; attribute-spec `constant_expression`; ANSI-port `expression`). All `parsed=true witnessed_target=false`, all real organic samples (no `@sample` shell — so NOT M1a).
- **MECHANISM:** the reach plan forces the path to the target's PARENT and selects the parent branch that references the target (e.g. `call_primary` is `Or[10]` with `context_member_method_call` at `o0` — forced), but it does NOT steer the TARGET rule's OWN internal structure; the target generates MINIMALLY, and the minimal form is sibling-ambiguous so the PEG parser attributes the bytes to an earlier sibling. Two sub-classes: **B-i (degenerate first alternative)** — the target is an `Or` whose `o0` is a bare pass-through a sibling also accepts (`array_range_expression` `o0=expression`; `callable_method_call_body` `o0=built_in_method_call`; `class_scoped_tf_call` `o0=class_scoped_tf_call_with_args`); the distinguishing forms are `o1+`. **B-ii (distinguishing token behind an optional)** — the target is a `Seq` whose distinguishing tokens sit behind a `?`/`*` minimal-expanded to absent (`context_member_method_call`'s `.method(args)` body; `goto_repetition`).
- **WHERE (pinned):** `directives_along_path` (`stimuli_generator.rs:5511`) + `set_reach_plan_for_rule` (`:2686`) force OR-branches + quantifiers ALONG the path (entry → the target's reference site) but stop AT the target — the target rule's own root `Or` + internal quantifiers are NOT in the plan, so the target body generates minimally (the degenerate/sibling-ambiguous form). The witness check (parser = judge) honestly reports `parsed=true witnessed_target=false`.
- **FIX DIRECTION (for `.3.2`):** steer the TARGET rule's own distinguishing structure — when a reach target is reached-but-not-witnessed, force its root `Or` toward a non-degenerate (non-pass-through) branch and/or its distinguishing internal quantifiers ≥1, retrying across the target's own alternatives until the parser witnesses it (parser stays the judge; bounded retries; off-reach byte-identical). Lineage = `RTL-FE-CLOSURE.5.3` (non-self-recursive-branch preference) extended to the target's OWN body.
- **PURE-DOCS ⇒ NO code/grammar/generated/release/schema/inventory/ledger change; clippy not invoked. Parser-family rows UNCHANGED** — SystemVerilog stays the only non-fully-certified shipped grammar (`UNKNOWN=93`). Frontier → `GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.5.3.2` (the M1b fix).

The B4 leaf of the SystemVerilog `UNKNOWN`→0 drive (`GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12`). Two of the residual 123 — `white_space` and `comment_only_source_region` — were proven **engine-shadowed-dead** and removed at source per the literal-0 doctrine (the vhdl `H.11.4-UNPARK` `white_space` precedent, one level up for `comment_only_source_region`). ## 2026-06-15 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0081 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.5.2, PURE-DOCS): the SV interface-class sv_2017 no_path is NOT a defect — LRM-faithful (candidate profile-orphan REFUTED)

The A2 adjudication leaf of the SystemVerilog `UNKNOWN`→0 drive (`GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12`). `H.12.5.1` had flagged the 5 sv_2023-only interface-class rules as a **candidate** profile-orphan defect. This slice ground that hypothesis against the IEEE LRMs, tools-first, and **refuted it**: the sv_2017 `no_path` is correct and LRM-faithful — wiring interface classes into sv_2017 would be the defect.

- **WHY (LRM-grounded):** IEEE **1800-2017** defines `interface_class_declaration` (§8.26.1 / A.1.2) but its formal grammar does NOT reference it as an alternative in `class_item` (`docs/systemverilog/2017/md/section-8-classes.md:95` carries `class_declaration` only), `package_or_generate_item_declaration` (`section-26-packages.md:60`), or `anonymous_program_item` — the 2017 LRM orphans `interface_class_declaration` in the source-text item hierarchy. IEEE **1800-2023** fixed this: `class_item` (`2023/md/section-8-classes.md:102`), `package_or_generate_item_declaration` (`section-26-packages.md:71`), and program items (`section-24-programs.md:133`) each add `| interface_class_declaration` next to `class_declaration` (2023 Annex A confirms `:519`/`:681`/`:696`).
- **PGEN faithfully mirrors both LRMs:** `interface_class_declaration` is referenced only from the `*_sv_2023` variants (`grammars/systemverilog.ebnf:490`/`:971`/`:3577`; `class_constructor_super_args` at `:915`). Under `--grammar-profile sv_2017` the interface-class subtree is therefore correctly unreachable, and wiring it into the sv_2017 variants would diverge PGEN from the 1800-2017 LRM (`project_ebnf_is_single_source_of_truth`, `feedback_no_codebase_change_without_tool_backed_facts`).
- **Witnessing evidence (the analogue of the A1 `library_text` proof):** a cert run with `--grammar-profile sv_2023` witnesses all 5 A2 rules (`interface_class_declaration`/`_item`/`_method`, `declared_interface_class_identifier`, `class_constructor_super_args` — none in that run's UNKNOWN/no_path lists; sv_2023 cert `total=1314 witness=1202 UNKNOWN=111 spf=0`).
- **Verdict + implication:** the 5 A2 rules are correct profile-relative `no_path` under sv_2017, certifiable under the sv_2023 profile — not removal, not sv_2017-wiring. With this, the **20 SV `no_path` are now fully adjudicated as NON-defects** (A1 11 alternate-entry-relative + A2 5 profile-relative + 4 blessed). Consequence for the SV `fully_certified` endgame: those 20 need a multi-profile/multi-entry accounting (A1 via per-entry runs, A2 via the sv_2023 profile, the 4 blessed), not an sv_2017 reach fix — recorded as an open endgame decision. The real `UNKNOWN`→0 work is the 103 reachable-but-unwitnessed (B1–B4); the next fix child is `H.12.5.3` (B4 `white_space` literal-0).

## 2026-06-15 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0078 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12.3, ENGINE FIX): 🎯 SV cert-coverage UNKNOWN 567→123 — the branch-`@sample` reach-honesty fix

The third leaf of the SystemVerilog `UNKNOWN`→0 drive (`GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.12`), and the largest single drop the certificate-coverage gate has seen. A generator **witness/reach-pass-only** engine fix — the parser, the AST shape, and the diverse certification pass are all untouched (no release/schema/wire change). SV remains the only non-fully-certified shipped grammar.

- **ROOT CAUSE (tools-first WHY+WHERE, not guessed):** an env-gated probe capture + reach-path dump (`PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DEBUG_PROBES=1` / `PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DEBUG_REACH=1`, since removed) showed the dominant `parsed-but-routed-elsewhere` residual was a fallback to a **canonical empty shell**: of the 130 unwitnessed `kw_*` keyword-token rules, **112 fell back to `module m; endmodule` (×57) or `program p; endprogram` (×55)**. The branch-level `@sample`/`@probe_sample` literal-override in `generate_or` (`stimuli_generator.rs:6822`) fired UNCONDITIONALLY — it never consulted the active reach plan. So when the plannable-rule reach pass steered THROUGH `module_declaration`'s branch-0 (`@sample:"module m; endmodule"`) or `program_declaration`'s (`@sample:"program p; endprogram"`) to witness a deep keyword, the override emitted the shell and never descended into the forced body where every gate-instantiation / specify-block / statement / assertion keyword lives. The reach-path dump confirmed the mechanism exactly: **57 failing reach paths force `module_declaration@…`, 55 force `program_declaration`** — matching the 57+55 shell buckets.
- **FIX (parser-agnostic, additive):** in `generate_or`, the branch literal-override stands down when the active reach plan FORCES this exact branch (`forced_branch_for(rule,node_path) == Some(selected_global)`), so the plan descends into the body. Off-reach (no plan, or a non-forced branch) is **byte-identical** — the gate computes `reach_forces_this_branch` only inside an active reach plan.
- **RESULT:** SV cert `UNKNOWN 567 → 123`, witness `726 → 1170` (+444), `spf=0`, deterministic at seeds 0/7/42 (`123/122/123`; the ±1 is the reach pass's wall-clock per-attempt timeout, not a structural wobble). The single fix CASCADED far beyond the 130 `kw_*` — descending into module/program bodies witnessed every deep construct + all intermediate rules along those paths (plannable `witnessed 442→896`, `parsed-but-routed-elsewhere 540→83`).
- **INERT for the fully-certified roster:** `rtl_const_expr`/`rtl_frontend`/`vhdl`/`json` carry **0** `@sample`; `regex`(1)/`systemverilog_preprocessor`(6) are `fully_certified`, so the plannable reach pass (which only runs when `UNKNOWN>0`) never fires for them. The rule-level gate + `on_path_rules` infrastructure explored first were REVERTED once the dump proved the short-circuit is branch-level (targeted-fix discipline — no code on a hypothesis).
- **VERIFIED (all green):** SV cert seeds 0/7/42 `UNKNOWN 123/122/123 spf=0`; `json 9/9`, `regex 198/198`, `systemverilog_preprocessor 74/74` stay `fully_certified` (rtl_const_expr/rtl_frontend/vhdl provably inert via 0 `@sample`); default lib **653/0** (+1 lock `reach_plan_forced_branch_suppresses_branch_sample_override` — control: off-reach `@sample` honored; fix: forced branch descends); clippy strict-source clean (generated stage = pre-existing 191-site tolerated debt); `regex_pcre2_compile_oracle_gate` PASS; `stimuli_cross_family_platform_gate` PASS (regex/vhdl/SV bounded replay).
- **Versioning:** generator witness/reach-pass only ⇒ NO release/schema/inventory/ledger change. Remaining SV `UNKNOWN 123` (the 20 `no_path` A1/A2 + the 18 `OTHER` constraint/sequence `kw_*` + deeper residual) → next leaf `H.12.5`.

The dead-code analysis sibling `compute_rule_reach_target` (not in any production reach plan) left unchanged.

## 2026-06-14 - PGEN-RTL-FE-CLOSURE-0014 (RTL-FE-CLOSURE.5.3, PURE-DOCS investigation checkpoint): 🔎 `based_integer` cert-coverage over-generation ROOT-CAUSED + fix DESIGNED; implementation deferred to a fresh session (delicate shared-reach-path change → mandatory decisive SV A/B). No code.

The `.5.3` leaf (the LAST Cluster-D target; `.5.6` witnessed `concatenation_expr`/`repetition_expr`) was root-caused tools-first. `based_integer` is the residual `UNKNOWN=3` member alongside `port_direction_token` (→`.5.1`) and `white_space` (engine-shadowed-dead).

- **Decisive diagnostic (a temporary `generate_plannable_rule_witnesses` probe for `based_integer`, now REMOVED per the `.5.5` temp-test precedent) dumped the real reach path + real construct-mode probe samples:**
- **(1) The reach BFS forces the ternary.** `conditional_expr` (grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf:220) = `logical_or_expr ? cond : cond` (BRANCH 0, ternary, **self-recursive**) `| logical_or_expr` (BRANCH 1, plain). `reach_hops`'s BFS (`collect_rule_reference_sites`, **first-site-wins**) discovers `logical_or_expr` via branch 0's site `root/o0/s0` before branch 1's `root/o1/s0`, so the directive forces `conditional_expr@root→0` = the ternary.
- **(2) The directive fires on every entry.** Keyed rule-relative `(conditional_expr, root)`, it fires for EVERY `conditional_expr` entry — including the off-path `packed_range` LSB (a fresh, non-recursive entry, count=1; `.5.6`'s `suppress_recursive_forced_branch` only catches recursive re-entries with `current_rule` ≥2× on the call stack). So both the msb and lsb `rtl_expr` become ternaries → `typedef bit[<ternary>:<ternary>]…` soup.
- **(3) Compounding lexical fusion (dominant reject mechanism).** `based_integer := /…'[sS]?[bBoOdDhH][0-9a-fA-FxXzZ?_]+/` — its value class **includes `?`**, so `<based_integer>?<digits>` (e.g. `78'sh49b?7380`) re-lexes as ONE token by maximal munch, eating the ternary `?`; the generic `\w` boundary heuristic does not separate them.
- **Decisive controls (`parseability_probe --parse rtl_frontend`):** `typedef bit[8'b1:0] x;` PARSES + witnesses `based_integer`; `typedef bit[8'b1 ? 2'b0 : 3'b1] x;` REJECTED **even with spaces** (a single ternary's `:` collides with `packed_range`'s `:`). ⇒ ATTRIBUTION: `based_integer` is genuinely reachable → a GENERATOR-REACH deficiency (not a grammar defect, not a parser bug).
- **Fix design (general/parser-agnostic; the `.5.4`/`.5.6` reach-honesty family):** make `reach_hops` prefer a **non-self-recursive** reference site when multiple sites in a rule reach the same target — for `conditional_expr`, discover `logical_or_expr` via branch 1 (plain) so the directive forces `conditional_expr@root→1`; every `conditional_expr` entry then takes the plain branch → minimal `bit[8'b1:8'b1]`-style witness → parses + witnesses, and the `?`-fusion vanishes with the ternary. Alternative (lexical-faithfulness separator after `based_integer`) kept as a fallback. **DELICATE:** `reach_hops` is shared, so the implementation must do a decisive git-stash SV A/B (no cert/witness regression) + deterministic seeds 0/7/42 + cross-family/contract gates (the reach search is also used by the closed-loop driver) + a retained regression test. Full implementation checklist is in the `.5.3` leaf. Frontier stays `.5.3` (now: implement the designed fix in a fresh session).

## 2026-06-14 - PGEN-RTL-FE-CLOSURE-0013 (RTL-FE-CLOSURE.5.6, CODE/GENERATOR-ONLY): 🎯✅ rtl_frontend Cluster-C RECURSIVE-FORCED-BRANCH FIXED for bang/tilde — certificate-coverage `UNKNOWN` 7→3 (OVER-DELIVERED past the planned 7→5) via a self-recursive forced-branch suppression in `generate_or`. NO release/schema/inventory/manifest/parser change (the -0072 generator-only precedent).

The `.5.6` leaf (split from `.5.5`) targeted the LAST Cluster-C reach sub-mechanism: `bang`/`tilde` produced ZERO probe samples and stayed `UNKNOWN`.

- **WHERE (tools-first, `grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf:258`):** `unary_expr := plus unary_expr | minus unary_expr | bang unary_expr | tilde unary_expr | primary_expr`. To witness `bang` the plannable reach pass forces the self-recursive `bang unary_expr` branch; the operand re-enters `unary_expr` at the SAME `(unary_expr, root)` directive site, so the directive RE-FIRES — `bang` is forced again and again (`!!!!…`) until the depth/visit budget exhausts and the construct fails. The only terminating branch (`primary_expr`) is never taken. The `.5.5` two-tier deep budget could not help: it only buys more recursion before the same failure.
- **FIX (generator-only, `rust/src/ast_pipeline/stimuli_generator.rs::generate_or`):** `suppress_recursive_forced_branch` — a forced directive at an OR site is suppressed (both `reach_bypass_branch` and `reach_forced_local` → `None`) when (a) a forced directive exists here, (b) its forced branch references `current_rule` (a self-recursive branch, detected via `collect_rule_references` — a true membership test, deliberately NOT `count_rule_references`, which returns >0 for ANY rule reference), and (c) `current_rule` appears ≥2 times on the live `call_stack` (a recursive RE-ENTRY — `generate_rule` pushes `current_rule` before the body, so the count is its live recursion depth). The reach pass runs in `witness_mode` + `construct_mode`, so the suppressed operand falls to the min-terminal-length ordering and commits to the shortest non-recursive alternative (`primary_expr`), terminating as `!a`/`~a`. The directive still fires ONCE on the shallow entry (`count == 1`), so the operator is selected and witnessed. Scoped to self-recursive forced branches only ⇒ every non-recursive directive is byte-identical. GENERAL/parser-agnostic (keyed on the structural self-reference + the live recursion count, never on rule names).
- **MEASURED:** rtl_frontend cert `UNKNOWN` 7→3, witness 163→167, `generation_failures` 31→0, byte-identical deterministic at seeds 0/7/42, `spf` 0 — witnessed `bang`, `tilde`, AND `repetition_expr` + `concatenation_expr` (the `.5.3` Cluster-D targets — reached because the operator reach path renders rich `typedef bit[<ternary range expr>]…` samples that also exercise the range forms; genuine parser-checked witnesses). RESIDUAL 3 = `port_direction_token` (`.5.1`, honestly no-reach-path) + `based_integer` (`.5.3`, now the LAST Cluster-D target) + `white_space` (engine-shadowed-dead). So `.5.3` shrinks to just `based_integer`.

TIER 2 (deeper: `reach_prefix + max(min_subtree, max_offpath_mandatory_sibling_depth)`) is tried ONLY when tier 1 did NOT witness AND a deep off-path mandatory sibling exists. **Strictly ADDITIVE** ⇒ no currently-witnessed reach rule's budget shifts, so no regression is possible by construction. ## 2026-06-14 - PGEN-RTL-FE-CLOSURE-0010 (RTL-FE-CLOSURE.5.4, CODE/GENERATOR-ONLY): 🎯✅ rtl_frontend Cluster-C force-entry-ROUTING ROOT CAUSE FIXED — certificate-coverage `UNKNOWN` 16→9 by making the plannable reach-path search ignore lookaheads. NO release/schema/inventory/manifest/parser change (the -0072 generator-only precedent).

The `.5.4` leaf framed the residual as a "force-entry ROUTING" gap (every probe falls back to "typedef bit X;"). A decisive tools-first investigation **refines** that: the routing was caused by a **negative-lookahead reach-poisoning** in the certificate-coverage plannable reach pass — not a forcing or depth gap.

- **Root cause (decisive, tools-first):** a focused `reach_hops` unit test on the REAL `rtl_frontend` grammar — RETAINED as the regression guard `reach_hops_skips_lookahead_only_references_real_rtl_frontend` — cross-checked against `PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DEBUG_PROBES=1` + `PGEN_TRACE_VERBOSITY=debug` forcing traces, proved the plannable reach-path BFS (`reach_hops` → `collect_rule_reference_sites`) **descended into lookahead nodes**. So every module-body keyword — all of which also appear in `non_keyword_identifier := !kw_always … !kw_wire simple_identifier` (grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf:348) — got a BOGUS shortest reach path `design_item(o0=typedef) → typedef_declaration → identifier → non_keyword_identifier → !kw_X`, forcing `design_item → branch 0 (typedef)`. But `generate_node` returns `Ok(String::new())` for any lookahead (it consumes no input), so that construct can NEVER positively emit/witness the keyword — generation falls back to the shortest `design_item` ("typedef bit X;") and routes elsewhere. Ground-truth: `reach_hops` returned `design_item→0` for `kw_always_latch`/`kw_localparam`/`kw_output`, vs `design_item→2` (module) for `kw_module` (whose POSITIVE `module_declaration` reference is a shorter BFS path than its lookahead reference) — and at `--count 2` ALL keywords witnessed-by-the-diverse-pass-at-40 route-to-typedef in the reach pass, proving the bug is GENERAL, not the rarer-construct subset.
- **Fix (generator-only, `rust/src/ast_pipeline/stimuli_generator.rs`, `collect_rule_reference_sites` — the shared reach-path helper used ONLY by `reach_hops` + the dead-code `compute_rule_reach_target`):** the `ASTNode::Lookahead` arm no longer recurses, so reach-path computation follows ONLY positively-emitted rule references. GENERAL/parser-agnostic (keyed purely on the `Lookahead` node shape; no rule names).
- **Measured:** rtl_frontend cert (`--report-certificate-coverage --entry-rule rtl_frontend_file --count 40`) `UNKNOWN` **16→9**, witness 154→161, `spf` 0, deterministic byte-identical at seeds 0/7/42. RESOLVED 7 leaves (`kw_localparam`/`kw_else`/`kw_begin`/`kw_end`/`kw_always_latch`/`kw_output`/`kw_inout` — each now reaches via its real POSITIVE path). `port_direction_token` becomes HONESTLY no-reach-path (referenced ONLY inside `( comma !port_direction_token port_item )*` — the `.5.1`/Cluster-B lookahead-only class; the fix surfaces that classification instead of chasing an unwitnessable path).

- **Cross-grammar (decisive git-stash A/B of `stimuli_generator.rs`, rebuilt both sides):** SystemVerilog cert `UNKNOWN` **627→627 BYTE-IDENTICAL** (witness 715→715, `spf` 0) — the fix reclassified 69 SV rules as no-reach-path (honest; e.g. `reserved_non_keyword_identifier`, `binary`/`octal`/`decimal`/`hex_number`) WITHOUT losing any witness; json + rtl_const_expr `fully_certified` (the reach pass never runs at `UNKNOWN==0` ⇒ provably inert).
- **Gates:** `clippy_on_rust_change` strict-source CLEAN (generated stage = pre-existing tolerated debt — all 191 generated-clippy errors are in `generated/*_parser.rs`, none in `stimuli_generator.rs`); pgen lib suite **744/744** incl. the new regression test; `rtl_frontend_generated_contract_gate` PASS (probe + handwritten replay — parser unchanged); `stimuli_cross_family_platform_gate` PASS (regex + vhdl + sv); book `grammar-wellformedness.md` plannable-reach lookahead-honesty note.

## 2026-06-14 - PGEN-RTL-FE-CLOSURE-0009 (RTL-FE-CLOSURE.5.2, CODE/GENERATOR-ONLY): 🎯✅ rtl_frontend Cluster-C reach gap FIXED — certificate-coverage `UNKNOWN` 66→16 via a per-target witness-pass depth budget. NO release/schema/inventory/manifest/parser change (the -0072 generator-only precedent).

The `.4` Cluster C (the dominant ~60-rule routed-elsewhere backlog) was attributed to a reach-plan force-entry gap. A decisive tools-first trace **refines and partly overturns** that: the reach plan's branch-forcing already works — the gap is a DEPTH-BUDGET limit in the certificate-coverage plannable witness pass.

- **Root cause (decisive, tools-first):** a 4.9 GB `PGEN_TRACE_VERBOSITY=debug` trace of the `generate_if` reach probe showed the forcing IS applied (`module_item`→branch 8, `generate_item`→branch 8=`generate_if`); the forced branch then fails with `Stimuli generation depth exceeded max_depth=48` because `generate_if`'s MANDATORY `rtl_expr` must descend the full ~15-level expression-precedence chain (`conditional_expr`→`logical_or_expr`→…→`primary_expr`→`signal_reference`→`scoped_identifier`→`identifier`) and bottoms out at depth 49 — one past the plannable witness pass's doubled `max_depth=48`. Generation then falls back to the shallow sibling (`typedef`/`parameter`), so the target re-parses-but-routes-elsewhere and never witnesses. Confirmed GENERAL: `parameter_override_list`/`continuous_assign`/`additive_op` all fail with the identical "depth exceeded" at the base of the expression chain.
- **Fix (generator-only, `rust/src/ast_pipeline/stimuli_generator.rs`, entirely inside `generate_plannable_rule_witnesses`):**
  1. a **per-target depth budget** = `original_max_depth * 2` (a generous reach-prefix allowance for the BFS-shortest path to even a deeply-nested target) **+ the target's own minimal-subtree depth** from a new structural fixpoint `compute_min_full_derivation_depths` / `min_full_derivation_depth_of_node` (the DEPTH analogue of the proven `compute_min_terminal_lengths`; min-aware quantifiers so `*`/`?` tails do not inflate the ceiling). Deep targets get exactly the depth their minimal witness needs; shallow/unwitnessable targets keep a tight budget and fail fast.
  2. **skip the redundant search fallback** when the construct attempt already TIMED OUT (identical budget → same timeout, pure doubled wall-clock).
  3. **break the per-rule retry loop on a timeout** (the retries re-roll terminal expansions for a `ParsedNotWitnessed` probe, not to outlast a budget-bound timeout).
- **Rejected-by-evidence (recorded):** a GLOBAL `deepest * 2` budget is correct but pathologically slow (2 min — unwitnessable targets ran to the 250 ms cap); a deeper `reach_prefix = deepest` REGRESSED cert (`UNKNOWN` 16→19, losing `literal`/`decimal_integer`/`real_number` to over-generation). So `original_max_depth * 2` is the prefix sweet spot.
- **Measured:** rtl_frontend cert (`--report-certificate-coverage --entry-rule rtl_frontend_file --count 40`) `UNKNOWN` **66→16**, witness 104→154, `spf` 0, BYTE-IDENTICAL deterministic at seeds 0/7/42; runtime ~18.8 s.
- **Cross-grammar (decisive git-stash A/B):** fully-certified grammars (json/regex/vhdl/svpp/rtl_const_expr) never run the reach pass (the `UNKNOWN==0` guard) ⇒ **provably inert** (json re-confirmed `fully_certified`). **SystemVerilog** (the only other `UNKNOWN`>0 grammar): cert `UNKNOWN` **645→627** (witness 697→715 — IMPROVED; the additive deeper budget witnessed 18 more SV rules), `spf` 0→0, and 2.5× FASTER (3m53s→1m33s; `generation_failures` 136→25) — a STRICT improvement, zero regression.
- **Residual 16 (honestly classified):** `port_direction_token`→`.5.1` (Cluster B lookahead-only); `repetition_expr`/`concatenation_expr`/`based_integer`→`.5.3` (Cluster D over-generation); + 11 keyword/operator leaves (`kw_localparam`/`kw_else`/`kw_begin`/`kw_end`/`kw_always_latch`/`kw_negedge`/`kw_or`/`kw_output`/`kw_inout`/`bang`/`tilde`, all probing to "typedef bit X;" — the forced construct fails and routes to the shortest `design_item`; NOT depth, confirmed by the deeper-budget A/B regressing) + `white_space` → NEW leaf `.5.4` (a SECOND Cluster-C sub-mechanism: force-entry ROUTING, distinct from the depth-exhaustion this leaf fixed).
- **Gates:** `clippy_on_rust_change` strict-source CLEAN (generated/lib-test stage = pre-existing tolerated debt, unchanged; no warning in `stimuli_generator.rs` at any edit locus); stimuli lib suite **157/157** incl. 2 NEW regression-guard tests (`min_full_derivation_depth_increases_along_a_rule_chain` + `plannable_witness_reaches_target_behind_deep_mandatory_chain`, the latter fails if the budget regresses to fixed `*2`); `rtl_frontend_generated_contract_gate` PASS (probe + handwritten replay); `stimuli_cross_family_platform_gate` PASS (regex + vhdl + sv bounded closed-loop replay); book `grammar-wellformedness.md` per-target depth-budget note + `mdbook_docs_gate`.
- **Versioning:** generator-only — NO release bump, NO AST-dump schema bump, NO annotation-inventory/manifest change, NO parser regen, NO ledger row (the shipped parser, its AST, and the accepted language are unchanged; only the closed-loop certificate-coverage witness pass reaches deeper-nested targets). Frontier → `RTL-FE-CLOSURE.5.4`.

## 2026-06-14 - PGEN-RTL-FE-CLOSURE-0007 (RTL-FE-CLOSURE.6, CODE/GENERATOR-ONLY): 🐛✅ seed-42 keyword-as-identifier `spf` FIXED in the closed-loop stimuli generator — the generator no longer out-generates its own parser for the `!kw … TERM` identifier shape. NO release/schema/inventory/manifest/parser change (the -0072 generator-only precedent).

The `.4` Cluster-E residual: at seed 42 the certificate-coverage diverse pass emitted a `typedef enum { ECg, UJl, if, fE, xNL6F }` where `if` is an enum-item identifier, which `non_keyword_identifier := !kw_if … simple_identifier` correctly rejects (`sample_parse_failures=1`) — a closed-loop round-trip self-inconsistency (the generator must not emit what its own parser rejects).

- **Fix (generator-only, `rust/src/ast_pipeline/stimuli_generator.rs`):** a thin `generate_sequence` wrapper detects the `!kw_A … !kw_Z TERM` shape *from grammar/HIR alone* — a leading run of negative lookaheads over fixed keyword-literal rules — and pushes the excluded whole-word spellings onto a scoped `keyword_identifier_exclusions` stack (extracted via `regex_fixed_literal`, which already treats the `\b` Look as empty, so both `/if\b/` and a bare `"if"` keyword form yield `"if"`). `generate_atom`'s regex arm then consults `sample_collides_excluded_keyword` and repairs a colliding identifier.
- **Mechanism decision (recorded — the interesting part):** the repair is a **DETERMINISTIC, RNG-NEUTRAL `_` prefix**, adopted *after a decisive A/B rejected a re-roll*. Re-roll advances the RNG, so it shifted the witness landscape of *unrelated* samples in the seed's stream — it regressed seed-7 (`witness 126→104`, `UNKNOWN 44→66`). The `_` prefix consumes no RNG (every other sample stays byte-identical), is a valid `simple_identifier` start that no keyword begins with — so `_`+keyword neither equals nor `\b`-prefix-matches any excluded keyword, covering BOTH the exact spelling AND the `keyword$…` edge that `\b` leaves open (satisfying the `.10` "mirror the `\b` exclusion including the `$`-edge" requirement) — and it re-parses to the *intended* identifier structure. A bounded re-roll remains only as a defensive fallback for a terminal forbidding a leading `_` (no current grammar). The shape detection is general (HIR-driven), not a per-sample patch.
- **Verified (tools-first):** reproduced the seed-42 spf=1 first on the clean pre-change binary. Post-fix `rtl_frontend` cert: seed-42 `spf` **1→0** with witness/UNKNOWN UNCHANGED (126/44); seeds 0 (104/66) + 7 (126/44) **byte-identical**; wider sweep seeds 1/2/3/5/13/99/100 all `spf=0`; determinism — seed-42 re-run byte-identical.
- **Zero cross-grammar regression (decisive):** a grammar sweep shows ONLY `rtl_frontend` (4) and `systemverilog` (9) carry the `!kw`/`non_keyword_identifier` shape — `vhdl`/`svpp`/`json`/`rtl_const_expr` have 0 (the wrapper never pushes ⇒ provably inert; confirmed byte-identical `fully_certified` at seeds 0/7/42); `regex` byte-identical; **SystemVerilog proven byte-identical by a git-stash A/B** of the diverse samples (identical md5 `06f3da83` pre/post — no collision at the measured seed).
- **Gates:** `clippy_on_rust_change` strict-source CLEAN (generated/lib-test stage = pre-existing tolerated non-strict debt); `rtl_frontend_generated_contract_gate` PASS (probe + handwritten replay — parser unchanged); `stimuli_cross_family_platform_gate` PASS (regex + vhdl + sv bounded closed-loop replay); `json` cert `fully_certified`; `mdbook_docs_gate` (book `stimuli-and-quality.md` gains "Mechanism 5 — keyword-as-identifier round-trip guard" + the portable-rule hazard list extended).
- **Versioning:** generator-only — NO release bump, NO AST-dump schema bump, NO annotation-inventory/manifest change, NO parser regen, NO ledger row (the shipped parser, its AST, and the accepted language are all unchanged). Frontier → `RTL-FE-CLOSURE.5.2`.

## 2026-06-14 - PGEN-CERT-GEN-BUDGET-0001 (CERT-GEN-BUDGET.1, pure-docs INVESTIGATION): 🔎 director-flagged misbehavior root-caused — `ast_pipeline --report-certificate-coverage` PASS-1 DIVERSE pass is TIME-UNBOUNDED (no B1 step-budget armed) → pathological/non-terminating + non-monotonic generation on the deeply-recursive `rtl_const_expr`. NEW tree `CERT-GEN-BUDGET`; fix ticketed `.2`. No code changed.

The director flagged "an `ast_pipeline` run stuck for 6.5 min" as a misbehavior to be task-tree tracked and investigated, never ignored (the be-alert / root-cause-fishy-immediately discipline). Tools-first root cause (clean pre-change debug binary):

- **It is NOT a deadlock.** The "stuck" run was the *canonical* `rtl_const_expr` certificate-coverage invocation (`--report-certificate-coverage --entry-rule conditional_expr --max-depth 32 --count 40`) being **pathologically slow** (≈40 × ~10s/sample ≈ 6.5 min), finite at depth 32.
- **Decisive datum — generation time is NON-MONOTONIC in `--max-depth`** (count 1, seed 0): depth 24 → instant `DepthExceeded` (the `conditional_expr → … → primary_expr → ( conditional_expr )` precedence chain is ~14 levels, so <~28 cannot reach a leaf); depth 28 → a SINGLE sample did NOT terminate within 200s (`rc=124 real=200.01s`, child observed 100% CPU then reaped — RSS ~21 MB, not a memory leak); depth 32 → succeeds in 18.15s/sample, `fully_certified` (48/48); depth 40 → again non-terminating within budget.
- **ROOT CAUSE (WHERE):** the cert-coverage PASS-1 *diverse* config (`rust/src/main.rs:2370`) is `StimuliConfig { seed, enforce_word_boundary_spacing: true, max_depth, ..Default::default() }`. `..Default::default()` leaves `target_generation_timeout_ms = 0` (`stimuli_generator.rs:208`); `timeout_budget_from_ms(0)` returns `None` (`:1682`), so `generate_many` → `generate_from_entry` never arms `active_generation_deadline`, and `generation_deadline_exceeded()` always returns false (`:1697`) ⇒ the **deterministic step-budget introduced by `GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.B1` (PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0005) — built precisely to bound generation — is NEVER ARMED for the diverse pass.** Unbounded by omission (intentional, to keep cert numbers byte-identical to historical behavior — the `main.rs:2370` comment), with an unanticipated non-terminating consequence on recursive grammars.
- **Severity:** generator / proof-tooling robustness — NOT a shipped-parser correctness bug (no parser/AST/release impact; cert numbers stay correct + deterministic WHEN the pass completes). But a core proof surface can effectively hang on a recursive grammar (presents as a critical hang) and makes `rtl_const_expr`'s canonical cert impractically slow / unrunnable at neighbouring depths.
- **Secondary (context, not this defect):** the SV `--count 40` >150s cost traces to the BOUNDED plannable-rule reach pass over 645 `UNKNOWN` rules (each probed ≤4× at `PLANNABLE_REACH_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS=250ms`, `main.rs:2490/2526`) — bounded-per-probe but many probes; SV's diverse pass at default depth 24 terminates fast.
- **Fix ticketed (`CERT-GEN-BUDGET.2`, pending, code leaf):** arm a generous deterministic step-budget for the diverse pass that bounds the rtl_const_expr depth-28/40 pathology while keeping the 6 well-behaved grammars (json/regex/systemverilog/vhdl/systemverilog_preprocessor/rtl_frontend) byte-identical and rtl_const_expr still `fully_certified` at depth 32 (decisive git-stash A/B). No code changed in this investigation slice.

## 2026-06-14 - PGEN-RTL-FE-CLOSURE-0006 (RTL-FE-CLOSURE.10, CODE/grammar): 🐛✅ rtl_frontend KEYWORD WORD-BOUNDARY over-rejection FIXED — each keyword regex embeds `\b` (`kw_X := trivia /literal\b/`, svpp idiom); keyword-prefixed identifiers (`input_data`/`reg_file`/`format`/`orange`) now accepted, exact keywords still rejected as identifiers, positive parsing byte-identical; release 1.0.4→1.0.5 / schema stays 3 (additive) / inventory stays 157; +2 manifest samples (130/98/32); cert UNKNOWN no-regress (66/44/44). A SECOND rtl_frontend acceptance bug, found while root-causing the `.6` seed-42 `spf` residual (fix-parser-bugs-ASAP). The generated parser **over-rejected** valid identifiers that merely START WITH a reserved-keyword spelling — `input_data`, `reg_file`, `format`, `orange`, `iffy` — though the handwritten baseline (intent oracle) accepts them: a gen⟷parse duality violation, the same class as `.9`.

- **Root cause:** keyword rules `kw_X := trivia "literal"` (`grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf`) had **no word boundary**, so they PREFIX-match; `non_keyword_identifier := !kw_always … !kw_wire simple_identifier` therefore over-rejects any identifier whose text prefix-matches a keyword (`!kw_input` fails on the `input` prefix of `input_data`). The handwritten baseline (`rtl_frontend/src/lib.rs:2912` `lex_identifier` reads a whole `is_ident_continue` token, `4332` `peek_keyword` does a WHOLE-TOKEN equality) accepts these. The `int`/`integer` *type* case is NOT affected — the engine backtracks ordered choices, so `integer x;` parses.
- **Fix (grammar-level, parser-agnostic, engine untouched):** embed a `\b` word boundary in each keyword regex — `kw_if := trivia /if\b/` — the proven systemverilog_preprocessor idiom (`kw_define := … /` + "`" + `define\b/`). The boundary lives INSIDE the keyword terminal, checked at its own match position with no intervening layout skip; `\b` also makes longer-vs-shorter keyword matching (`always` vs `always_comb`, `int` vs `integer`) order-independent. **0 new grammar rules** (rule count stays 170, inventory stays 157/74).
- **Rejected alternative (recorded):** a *separate* boundary rule `id_cont := /[A-Za-z0-9_$]/` consulted via `!id_cont` was tried and **rejected by decisive evidence** — generated regex terminals ALWAYS consume leading layout first (`ast_based_generator.rs:3640` hardcodes `match_regex(skip_leading_whitespace=true)` for every regex rule except `string_content_double`/`single`), so the separate boundary saw PAST the space after a keyword and broke EVERY `keyword identifier` (`package`/`module`/`wire` all rejected). The `[>]`/`[>!]` lexical follow-restrictions were also ruled out: a source grep proved they are consumed ONLY by the stimuli generator (`apply_lexical_follow_restriction`) and the annotation extractor — NOT wired into the generated parser, so they cannot change parse acceptance.
- **Verified (tools-first):** keyword-prefix probe matrix — `input_data`/`reg_file`/`orf`/`ifc`/`iffy`/`format`/`ifx`/`orange`/`input1`/`forge` all **ACCEPT** (all REJECT pre-fix); exact `if`/`for`/`or` still **REJECT** as identifiers; `logic`/`int`/`integer`/`typedef integer`/`package`/`ready` byte-identical **ACCEPT**. Handwritten-baseline intent-oracle parity confirmed at runtime (`rtl_frontend_generated_contract_gate` handwritten-replay stage PASS on the 2 new samples). cert-coverage `UNKNOWN` no-regression: seeds 0/7/42 = 66/44/44 (seed-7 improved from 66; `spf` 0/0/1, seed-42 `spf=1` = pre-existing `.6` residual). Zero cross-grammar regression (only `grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf` changed; `json` cert `fully_certified`; `stimuli_cross_family_platform_gate` PASS).
- **Gates:** `rtl_frontend_generated_contract_gate` PASS (probe + handwritten replay; **130** samples / **98** accepts / 32 rejects after +2 keyword-prefixed-identifier ACCEPT samples; 232 typed-value locks / 74 samples); `rtl_frontend_ast_shape_contract` PASS (157 inventory); rtl_frontend crate **91/91**; pgen rtl_frontend lib **5/5** (a stale `.3`-era `contract_version` `"0.1.0"` assertion — only surfaced now because the gate uses the probe binary, not this lib test — realigned to `"0.2.0"`); `rtl_frontend_parser_book_gate` PASS (tracked HTML regen); `mdbook_docs_gate` PASS; clippy strict-source clean.
- **Versioning:** release `1.0.4`→`1.0.5`, AST-dump schema **stays `3`** (additive — every `1.0.4`-accepted input byte-identical, new identifiers reuse the existing `identifier` shape), inventory **stays `157`/74** (keyword rules carry no return annotation), manifest `contract_version` stays `0.2.0`. Docs lockstep (9 book chapters + tracked HTML + integration contract + README + top-level book) same-wave.
- **Known residual (honest):** regex `\b` uses `\w = [A-Za-z0-9_]`, which excludes `$`; `simple_identifier` allows `$`, so the rare `keyword$…` identifier (e.g. `if$x`) is still rejected. Closing it needs a precise no-layout lexical boundary assertion (a parse-enforced `[>!]` follow-restriction, or a no-layout regex) — a future parser-agnostic capability, out of scope here. `.6` keeps the closed loop round-trip-safe by mirroring this `\b` keyword-exclusion when generating identifiers.

`rtl_frontend` stays `In Progress`. Frontier → `RTL-FE-CLOSURE.6` (seed-42 keyword-as-identifier `spf`; now a clean exact-equal generator guard).

## 2026-06-13 - PGEN-RTL-FE-CLOSURE-0005 (RTL-FE-CLOSURE.9, CODE/grammar): 🐛✅ rtl_frontend bare-ANSI-port ACCEPTANCE GAP FIXED — `port_group` two-branch lookahead split; bare `input R`/`output R`/`inout R` now accepted; release 1.0.3→1.0.4 / schema stays 3 (additive) / 156→157 annotations; cert UNKNOWN 71→66 (Cluster-A leaves witnessed). Engine untouched.

The highest-priority frontier leaf of the active `RTL-FE-CLOSURE` tree — the `.4`-root-caused Cluster-A grammar defect (fix-parser-bugs-ASAP). The generated rtl_frontend parser **rejected** valid bare ANSI ports (`input R` / `output R` / `inout R` — direction + name, no data type, no packed range) though the handwritten baseline (intent oracle) accepted them: a gen⟷parse duality violation.

- **Root cause:** in `port_group := port_direction data_type? packed_range? port_item …` (`grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf:102`) the greedy PEG `data_type?` — whose `named_data_type := identifier` alternative matches **any** bare identifier — absorbed the port *name*, leaving nothing for `port_item` (`"did not consume full input at position 0"`). Typed (`input logic R`) / ranged (`input [1:0] R`) ports survived because `data_type?` / `packed_range?` consumed *that* instead of the name.
- **Fix (grammar-level, parser-agnostic, engine untouched):** `port_group` split into **two branches** mirroring the existing `parameter_declaration_head` `&( data_type identifier )` lookahead idiom already in the grammar — a typed branch `port_direction &( data_type packed_range? port_item ) data_type packed_range? port_item … -> {direction: $1, data_type: $3, packed_range: $4, ports: [$5, $6::3*]}` (takes a leading `data_type` only when a positive lookahead confirms a port name still follows it, allowing an optional `packed_range` between type and name) and a no-type branch `port_direction packed_range? port_item … -> {direction: $1, data_type: [], packed_range: $2, ports: [$3, $4::3*]}` for the bare form. A single-rule lookahead-guarded-optional alternative was **tried and rejected by evidence** (it corrupts the typed `data_type` to `[[], {...}]` — the positional-model leak; the two-branch form is byte-identical).
- **Verified (tools-first):** bisect ladder — bare `input/output/inout R` + multi + mixed (`input logic a, output b`) all **ACCEPT**; typed/ranged/typed-ranged/named-type ports **ACCEPT** with **byte-identical** AST vs baseline. cert-coverage `UNKNOWN` 71→66 deterministic at seeds 0/7 (witness 99→104, `spf=0`); `port_list`/`port_group`/`port_item`/`port_direction`/`kw_input`/`kw_output`/`kw_inout` moved UNKNOWN→**witnessed**; `port_direction_token` correctly still UNKNOWN (Cluster B / `.5.1`); seed-42 `spf=1` is the pre-existing `-0072`/`.6` residual. Zero cross-grammar regression (only `grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf` changed; engine binary unchanged; `json` cert `fully_certified`; `stimuli_cross_family_platform_gate` PASS).
- **Versioning (policy-correct):** release `1.0.3`→`1.0.4`, **AST-dump schema stays `3`** — per the schema-versioning chapter's *Additive-vs-breaking* rule a previously-unparseable construct now parsing into the *existing* `port_group` shape is additive (all `1.0.3` inputs byte-identical), matching the `-0075` accept-set-fix precedent; annotation inventory `156`→`157`/`74` (new no-type branch annotation). No bug-ledger row (rtl_frontend is `In Progress`). No new EBNF construct ⇒ no `ebnf.ebnf` meta-grammar lockstep.
- **Gate-enforced + lockstep:** `rust/test_data/ast_shape_contract/rtl_frontend_v1.json` inventory 156→157 (`port_group` branch-0 re-indexed + branch-1 added) — shape-contract test PASS; generated-contract manifest +3 bare-ANSI-port ACCEPT samples (128 / 96 / 32; 225 typed-value locks / 72 samples) — `rtl_frontend_generated_contract_gate` PASS; `rtl_frontend` crate 91/91. Docs same-wave: rtl_frontend book (8 chapters + tracked HTML, `rtl_frontend_parser_book_gate` PASS), integration contract (Contract Identity 1.0.4/157 + schema row + Release 1.0.4 Highlights), README, top-level book (`parser-families` + `cli-and-workflows`, `mdbook_docs_gate` PASS). clippy strict-source clean.
- **Files:** `grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf`, `rust/test_data/ast_shape_contract/rtl_frontend_v1.json`, `rust/test_data/grammar_quality/rtl_frontend_generated_parity_contract_v0.json`, `docs/rtl_frontend_parser_book/src/{schema-versioning,changelog-index,rules-top-level,json-carrier,glossary,welcome,walking-the-ast,ast-envelope,examples-binary-addition,quickstart}.md` + regenerated `docs/rtl_frontend_parser_book-html/`, `docs/contracts/PGEN_RTL_FRONTEND_PARSER_INTEGRATION_CONTRACT.md`, `README.md`, `docs/book/src/{parser-families,cli-and-workflows}.md`, `docs/tasks/RTL-FE-CLOSURE.md`, `docs/TASK_TREE.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `LIVE_ACHIEVEMENT_STATUS.md`, `CHANGES.md`, `DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md`. ## 2026-06-13 - PGEN-RTL-FE-CLOSURE-0004 (RTL-FE-CLOSURE.4, pure docs): 🔎 rtl_frontend UNKNOWN=71 ROOT-CAUSE INVESTIGATION — five causal clusters pinned tools-first; refines .1's "all generator-reach"; one genuine grammar defect found. No code changed; status rows unchanged.

This is the `.4` investigation leaf of the active `RTL-FE-CLOSURE` tree. `.1` scoping had *inferred* (from a clean linter + a reach pass with 0 no-path) that the whole `UNKNOWN=71` was a generator-reach deficiency with no grammar defect. `.4` does the per-rule probing that inference deferred — and partly **overturns** it: the linter's deliberately-sound subset does not decide PEG greedy-optional ambiguity or lookahead-only unwitnessability, so a clean linter never actually ruled out a grammar defect.

- **Method (all read-only):** reproduced `.1` deterministically (`PGEN_CERT_COVERAGE_DEBUG_PROBES=1 ast_pipeline … --report-certificate-coverage --entry-rule rtl_frontend_file --count 40 --seed 0` → `total=170 witness=99 UNKNOWN=71`; reach pass `131 → 50/67/37/20`); parsed the 354 plannable-probe lines into per-rule verdicts (50 WITNESSED / 67 ROUTED_ELSEWHERE / 9 NEVER_PARSED + 5 pure GEN_FAILURE = 81 non-self-witnessed); bisected with `parseability_probe --parse`; read the grammar + the handwritten baseline (the intent oracle); A/B-tested the seed-42 failing sample.
- **Five causal clusters pinned with decisive tool evidence:**
  - **(A) GRAMMAR DEFECT / real parser ACCEPTANCE GAP (→ new highest-priority leaf `.9`, fix-parser-bugs-ASAP).** Bare ANSI ports — `input R` / `output R` / `inout R` (direction + name, no type, no packed range) — are **rejected** ("did not consume full input at position 0"). Root cause: in `port_group := port_direction data_type? packed_range? port_item …` (`grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf:102`) the greedy PEG `data_type?` — whose `named_data_type := identifier` alternative (line 285) matches **any** bare identifier — absorbs the port-name identifier, leaving nothing for `port_item`. Bisect: `input R`/`output R`/`inout R` REJECT, but `input logic R` / `input wire R` / `input bit R` / `input [1:0] R` ACCEPT. The handwritten baseline (intent oracle) **accepts** bare ports (`rtl_frontend/src/lib.rs:3192` keeps `data_type` optional; `3992` treats a bare identifier as a type only when it is a registered type alias, else returns `None`) ⇒ a gen⟷parse duality violation, not an intended rejection. Invisible because the curated manifest has **0/121** bare-direction ports. Instances the standing `feedback_grammar_rules_must_consult_store`.
  - **(B) LOOKAHEAD-ONLY rule (→ `.5.1`).** `port_direction_token` is the unique rule referenced only in `( comma !port_direction_token port_item )*` — the positive transactional coverage primitive can never witness a `!`-guarded rule. A coverage-semantics residual, not a bug.
  - **(C) GENERATOR-REACH force-entry gap (dominant, ~60 rules → `.5.2`).** The reach plan forces a path to an ancestor referencing the target leaf, but construct-mode minimization then emits an unrelated minimal `design_item` (kw_input→`typedef bit b5cC;`, additive_op→`package Wcv;endpackage`, continuous_assign→`module …;parameter …;endmodule`) so the probe parses yet never contains the target. Confirmed NOT a coverage bug (positively-used keyword leaves `kw_module`/`kw_endmodule`/`kw_typedef`/`kw_bit` are witnessed).
  - **(D) CONSTRUCT-MODE EXPRESSION OVER-GENERATION (→ `.5.3`).** `based_integer`/`concatenation_expr`/`repetition_expr`/`literal` (+ ~5 gen-failure rules) get malformed deep `bit[…]` ternary-soup ranges the parser correctly rejects; simple `[1:0]` ranges parse fine.
  - **(E) seed-42 `spf=1` (→ `.6`).** The single seed-42 diverse-pass failing sample (rejected at position 816) contains an enum item spelled `if`; the generator emits a reserved-keyword spelling where `non_keyword_identifier := !kw_… simple_identifier` (line 333) forbids it. A/B: `enum {ECg,UJl,fE}` ACCEPT vs `enum {ECg,if,fE}` / `enum {ab,or}` / `wire for` REJECT.
- **Fix tickets authored:** new highest-priority leaf `.9` (Cluster A grammar fix), children `.5.1`/`.5.2`/`.5.3` (Clusters B/C/D), and a refined `.6` (Cluster E). New frontier → `.9` (fix-parser-bugs-ASAP outranks the generator-reach umbrella).
- **Blast radius:** docs only (`docs/tasks/RTL-FE-CLOSURE.md`, continuity docs). No grammar/Rust/generated/manifest change. Status rows unchanged (`rtl_frontend` stays `In Progress`).

## 2026-06-11 - PGEN-RTL-FE-CLOSURE-0001 (RTL-FE-CLOSURE.2, pure docs): 🔎 the -0067/-0075 red `rtl_frontend_generated_contract_gate` ticket is ADJUDICATED — NOT a parser bug; a STALE PROOF SURFACE (the April-era curated parity manifest vs the released typed schema-3 carrier). Tree RTL-FE-CLOSURE activated; fix design ticketed as `.3`.

Tools-first root cause of the stable red signature `always_ff_well_formed missing required rule 'module_declaration'`:

- **WHY:** the curated manifest (`rust/test_data/grammar_quality/rtl_frontend_generated_parity_contract_v0.json`, authored 2026-04-08, last touched 2026-04-20 — when `grammars/rtl_frontend.ebnf` carried ZERO return annotations) asserts raw-envelope AST retention: `required_rule_names`/`required_rule_texts`/`expected_rule_texts` walk the dumped AST for `rule_name`+`span` keys. The RELEASED typed-AST campaign (RTL-FE Slices 1–7 from 2026-05-14, then releases 1.0.2/1.0.3 with schema 1→3 on 2026-05-17) annotated the structural rules (`design_item -> {kind, body:$1}`, `module_declaration -> {name:$2, …}`), folding those subtrees into typed `ParseContent::Json` with no `rule_name` keys. Measured: the failing sample's dump contains exactly ONE `rule_name` (the entry `rtl_frontend_file`); all 14 required rules are absent. ## 2026-06-11 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0075 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.11.5-FIX): 🐛✅ ENGINE FIX — released SV parser bug FIXED via static emit-time per-introducer comment-arm suppression; SV release 1.0.138→1.0.139 (schema stays 3), ledger row SV-0001; THE H.11 ARC IS CLOSED

The `-0074`-designed fix landed with one decisive-A/B-driven refinement. The generated layout skippers' hard-coded comment arms (`#`-to-EOL, `//`-to-EOL, `/* */`) are now suppressed STATICALLY at parser-emit time for every introducer the grammar assigns a NON-COMMENT meaning, in BOTH skippers (`consume_layout_for_regex` and `consume_layout_for_terminal`). This closes the dual case the `-0067` dynamic guard cannot cover (the active-token guard does not stop an arm from stealing a DIFFERENT token's introducer during speculation, where the stolen span is then memoized and poisons the true parse path).

- **Claim analysis (`ast_based_generator.rs`, parser-agnostic):** a regex terminal claims an introducer only when EVERY match mandatorily starts with it (`hir_mandatory_prefix` — a content class like `[^\r\n]*` that merely CAN start with it is no claim) and the pattern is not itself comment-DEFINING (mandatory introducer head + unbounded tail — SV `line_comment`/`block_comment`); a literal terminal claims via starts_with unless it sits in the two-token comment shape (introducer literal immediately followed by an unbounded content terminal, one-hop rule deref — the ebnf `("#" | "//") comment_content` idiom). Per grammar: SV/vhdl/rtl_frontend lose the `#` arm (`hash := trivia "#"`, `/#/`, `#` overrides); every other arm/grammar keeps byte-equivalent status quo.
- **Refinement adjudication (decisive stash A/B):** the leaf's original any-claim criterion regressed the generated-ebnf dual-run flow (baseline 1 failing flow [regex `**`-gap, pre-existing], ebnf consumed 100%; any-claim → 2 flows, ebnf 15.32% — the generated ebnf parser relied on the arms for mid-rule comments the meta-grammar does not structurally own). Post-refinement the gate is byte-identical to its pre-existing state.
- **Verified (full matrix, all 10 parsers regenerated canonically):** repro family (`/tmp/h112_bisect/y*.sv`, 618-byte `/tmp/h115_f0.sv`) REJECT→PASS with all controls PASS; SV cert-coverage seed-0 `sample_parse_failures` **1→0** (seeds 0/7/42; witness/UNKNOWN byte-identical 697/645); SV external corpus clean; vhdl fully_certified seeds 0/7/42 + 16-seed sweep `[0×16]` + corpus 8/8; svpp 32/32 seeds fully_certified spf=0; json/regex/rtl_const_expr fully_certified spf=0; rtl_frontend 99/71 byte-identical (seed-42 spf=1 stays the pre-existing ticket); rtl_frontend contract gate red with the IDENTICAL pre-existing signature; oracle + cross-family + mdbook + SV-book gates PASS; default lib 646/0 (+4 analysis locks), dual-feature 741/0 (+`systemverilog_hash_token_is_not_stolen_by_comment_arms_during_speculation`); clippy strict-source clean (generated stage = pre-existing tolerated debt).
- **Consumer surface:** SV release `1.0.139` (acceptance widening only for grammar-valid inputs, non-breaking; schema stays 3); ledger `SV-0001` added; the `VHDL-0002` note's generator-side adjudication superseded in-row; SV contract + SV parser book (schema table + changelog index + HTML) + top-level book grammar-wellformedness chapter synced same-wave.

## 2026-06-11 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0074 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.11.5 investigation): 🚨 RE-ADJUDICATED (pure docs, tools-first) — the SV canonical seed-0 cert-coverage failure is NOT generator over-generation but a RELEASED SV PARSER BUG: the second instance of the `-0067` layout-skipper comment-arm defect family, in the dual case the `-0067` guard does not cover.

The `-0067` adjudication ("generator `/`↔comment fusion; parser right to reject") is refuted by a deeper trace. Bisection of the canonical 618-byte failing sample produced a minimal repro — `interface i #  (  ) ;timeunit 09 ns//>Mg`↵`//QF.`↵`/633 s;endinterface` rejects while every single-comment, no-`#()`, and block-led variant passes. The full trace pins the mechanism decisively: while the parser speculatively attempts `line_comment` after `interface i`, the emitted skipper's hard-coded `#`-to-EOL comment arm fires at the `#` of `# ( )` (in SV `#` is a real token; the `-0067` guard only stands the arms down when the ACTIVE pattern matches at the introducer, and `//…` does not match at `#`), swallows `#  (  ) ;timeunit 09 ns//>Mg` to end-of-line, the regex then matches the SECOND comment (`line_comment` "advanced from 11 to 47"), the bogus `trivia@11→47` is memoized, and the real ANSI-header path dies on it (`Terminal '#' failed at position 47 — found '/'`, 4 memo-poison reuse sites). This also explains why two comments are required: the second gives the post-theft cursor a matchable `//`, turning the bogus skip into a memoizable "success".

- **Fix design recorded in the leaf (own slice, highest priority per fix-parser-bugs-ASAP):** suppress the skipper's comment arms STATICALLY at emit time, per introducer — if any grammar terminal can start with `#`/`//`/`/*`, that arm must not be emitted for that grammar (SV defines `#` ⇒ no `#` arm; retroactively, vhdl defines `/#/` ⇒ the rule would have prevented `VHDL-0002` too). Consumer-visible: SV release bump + ledger row + contract/book lockstep + all-parsers regen + cross-family/sweep verification.
- Repro corpus retained: `/tmp/h115_f0.sv`, `/tmp/h112_bisect/{v*,w*,x*,y*}.sv`, traces `y4_trace.log`/`y4_full.log`.
- **Files:** `docs/tasks/GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.md`, `docs/TASK_TREE.md`, `LIVE_ACHIEVEMENT_STATUS.md`, `MEMORY.md`, `CHANGES.md`, `DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md`.

## 2026-06-10 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0068 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED Decisions): 📐 META-GRAMMAR COMPLETENESS AUDIT (pure docs) — the generated ebnf parser vs the real EBNF language: SIX gaps, not one.

Executable audit (the generated ebnf parser over all 12 shipped grammars + ~30 single-construct minimal probes): **6/12 grammars fail to fully parse**, and the construct-level verdicts pin six gaps — (1) per-branch return annotations (`A -> ann | B -> ann`; the dominant gap, first-failure of 5 of the 6 failing files; ubiquitous usage), (2) `::N*` extraction-spread (152 live sites, SV 115), (3) `**` flatten-spread (regex), (4) lexical annotations `[> …]`/`[>! …]` (12 svpp sites), (5) dotted `$refs` in return annotations (25 SV + 2 regex sites), (6) indexed `$refs` in return annotations (no live usage yet). Impact: nothing user-facing today (production compiles via the hand-written frontend); the gaps block the self-hosting doctrine and keep `ebnf_frontend_dual_run_gate` red. ## 2026-06-10 - PGEN-GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED-0067 (GRAMMAR-WELLFORMED.H.11.3): 🔧 ENGINE FIX — the vhdl released-parser based-literal bug is FIXED (layout-skipper comment-introducer guard for regex terminals); vhdl release `1.0.3`→`1.0.4` (schema stays 3), ledger `VHDL-0002`; vhdl cert-coverage `UNKNOWN 4→1`, rtl_frontend `73→71`, SV `647→645`.

WHY pinned by reading the emitted code (both -0066 suspects — tournament-arm restore, memo end — refuted): the generated layout skipper `consume_layout_for_regex` hard-codes `#`-to-end-of-line comment skipping (plus `//`, `/* */`) into every non-blocklisted generated parser — an EBNF meta-grammar convention, while in VHDL `#` is the based-literal delimiter. Its string-terminal sibling `consume_layout_for_terminal` has always guarded against swallowing comment-introducer tokens; the regex side had NO symmetric guard, so `hash := trivia /#/` had its own `#` eaten as a "comment" (decisive trace: the `/#/` regex executed at position 58=EOF after the skipper consumed `#1010#;…` to end-of-line — the -0066 "41→58 jump" was the skipper inside `parse_white_space`/`parse_hash`).
